mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (tenant_id, recipient_id, type, title, content, link, ref_type, ref_id, status, channels_json) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{recipientId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{link}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{status}, #{channelsJson})
